step1.label: Step 1 of 8
step1.question: Who do you wish you talked to more?

step2.label: Step 2 of 8
step2.headline: You're not alone.
step2.subhead: Most of us spend around 2½ hours a day in the feed.
step2.body: Presence helps you turn a few of those minutes back toward someone real.
step2.statLabel:
hours a day
in the feed

step3.label: Step 3 of 8
step3.headline: Your phone can point you back to the people who matter.
step3.subhead: An ally in your pocket, not a warden.
step3.body: When it's time to unwind, Presence nudges you toward someone you love — not just the feed.

step4how.label: Step 4 of 8
step4how.title: Here's how Presence works.
step4how.subtitle: A small challenge every time. A real connection every day.
step4how.step1Desc: Your chosen apps lock automatically at your set time.
step4how.step2Desc: We pick a trusted contact and one specific word — like "proud" or "berlin" — you need to use in a text to them.
step4how.step2DescHighlight: We also write personalised prompts for each person, so you always know what to say.
step4how.step3Desc: Send a genuine message that includes the challenge word, then screenshot the conversation — message and date must be visible.
step4how.step4Desc: Verified in seconds. Your apps come back, streaks build, and every few connections you unlock a new milestone.
step4how.hint: Every block cycle picks a fresh word — no more re-uploading the same screenshot.

step4.label: Step 5 of 8
step4.title: When should Presence protect you?
step4.subtitle: Your apps lock at this time every day. You unlock them by reaching out to someone real.

step6contacts.label: Step 6 of 8
step6contacts.title: Who keeps you grounded?
step6contacts.subtitle: Add the people you commit to reaching out to. Reaching one of them is all it takes.
step6contacts.hint: Each time your apps are blocked, you'll need to message one of these people to unlock them.
step6contacts.ocrNote: When you upload a screenshot, we look for these names in the conversation.
step6contacts.changeLater: You can add or remove contacts at any time from your profile.
step6contacts.empty: Add at least one person to continue.
step6contacts.q1Hint: School friend, sibling, colleague — keep it short.
step6contacts.q2Hint: A new role, a milestone, something they're working through.
step6contacts.q2Placeholder: Just started a new job at a law firm...
step6contacts.q3Label: What do you most appreciate about {{name}}?
step6contacts.q3Hint: Optional. Helps us write warmer prompts.
step6contacts.q3Placeholder: Always knows what to say when I need it...
step6contacts.q4Label: Anything you've been meaning to say or ask {{name}}?
step6contacts.q4Placeholder: Been meaning to apologise for missing the wedding...
step6contacts.generatingBody: One moment. We're tuning these to who they are.
step6contacts.previewBody: Tomorrow, we might gently remind you to:
step6contacts.previewFooter: We'll loosely match your messages against this and the other prompts we wrote. Review or refresh them anytime in your profile.
step6contacts.errorTitle: We couldn't write prompts right now.
step6contacts.errorBody: {{name}} is saved. You can try again from your profile.
step6contacts.errorBodyStrict: {{name}} couldn't be set up. Try again, or cancel to start over.
step6contacts.errorToastBody: Couldn't generate prompts for {{name}}. Check your connection and try again.
step6contacts.notifPromptBody: We'll remind you 15 minutes before your apps lock so you can reach out to {{name}}. You can change this later in Settings.

step5.label: Step 7 of 8
step5.title: Which apps distract you most?
step5.subtitle: Select the ones Presence will shield.
step5.selectHint: Select at least one to continue.

step7.label: Step 8 of 8
step7.title: Your real life is waiting.
step7.social: A year of real connection, for less than a few coffees.
step7.benefit1: Your apps lock. Your focus returns.
step7.benefit3: Streaks and insights that keep you going.
step7.benefit4: The only app that turns screen time into real connection.

blockTime.startsTomorrowSoon: Heads up — less than 2 minutes away. Your shield will start tomorrow at {{time}}.
blockTime.screenTimeOffBody: Tap here to re-enable it in Settings so Presence can lock your apps at the scheduled time.
blockTime.screenTimeNearTitle: Screen Time needs to be on
blockTime.screenTimeNearBody: Your block time is almost here and Screen Time is disabled. Tap here to fix it in Settings.

blockTime.lockedBody: Reach out to someone real and verify it to unlock. You can change your schedule and apps once you're free.

notifications.warmupBody: Your scroll shield goes up in 15 minutes. Who haven't you spoken to in a while?
notifications.warmupBodyTargeted: Shield up in 15 min. Don't forget to {{line}}

shield.title: Replace meme sending with actual genuine connection. Text someone, upload the screenshot, and unlock your apps.
shield.failure: We couldn't verify this connection. Try a clearer screenshot.
shield.failureNoContactTitle: We couldn't read a trusted contact's name.
shield.failureNoContactBody: Make sure their name appears in the conversation — spelled exactly as you saved it in your messaging app.
shield.failureNoContactNamedBody: This challenge is for {{name}}. Make sure their name appears in the conversation, spelled exactly as you saved it in your messaging app.
shield.failureNoWordBody: Your message must include the word "{{word}}". Send a fresh text with it, then re-upload the screenshot.
shield.failureTooOldBody: This one was taken a while ago. Take a new screenshot of your conversation and try again.
shield.failureNoThemeBody: Try mentioning something specific to {{name}} — their work, family, or what's on their mind.
